column1: # achievement-descriptors - the 41 static 0x198-byte achievement records at 01DFE410 (FABLE, 2026-09-17).
# record: address of the record (base 01DFE410 + slot*0x198); counter_id: the qword at +0x00, the counter id the contract page's save layout uses;
# tag: the developer string the qword at +0x08 points to; title: the inline Steam display title at +0x10; other_strings: further printable runs inside the record.
# The unlock body indexes this array at [manager+8] + index*0x198 (steam page, UQ-275); byte +0x190 = unlocked, dword +0x194 cleared on unlock.
